review.method: Review complete static template/header/footer/style sources, including below-fold markup and inactive examples. Prune only simple single-class rules mapped to Bootstrap's generated utility mixin. Retain every component, grid, state, compound selector and unknown source; keep source order and all media conditions.
review.dynamicClassReview: Existing app initialization toggles open/on/affix/show/active, text-success, d-none/d-block and alert-success/alert-danger. Bootstrap/HSMegaMenu interaction classes are in retained component/vendor sources; dynamic utility classes are safelisted. No JavaScript is modified.

excludedThemeSources./pages/_login-signup.scss: No login/signup form/wrapper or error-content markup on either target or shared chrome. Login links remain intact.
excludedThemeSources./themes/_theme-switcher.scss: No theme-setting/customize-color markup on either target or shared chrome; existing app initializer is DOM-guarded. Base colors remain in retained color/background sources.

review.preservedThemeSources: All other theme source groups, including blog/utility/pricing generic selectors, hero, map, forms, accordion, header/footer, offcanvas, helpers, animations and responsive rules.
review.fontPolicy: Reuse the existing reviewed Font Awesome icon inventory and fonts without regenerating subsets. Inter import removal/direct enqueue remains exactly as before.
